# coolify_team (Data Source)

The team the configured API token belongs to, with its members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_team" "current" {}

output "team_name" {
  value = data.coolify_team.current.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Team description.
- `id` (Number) Numeric team id.
- `members` (Attributes List) Team members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `name` (String) Team name.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) User email.
- `id` (Number) User id.
- `name` (String) User name.
